count_scope: Every committed reducer partition; count every input record once
accurate: Existing Java value-domain and reference checks; not factual real-world accuracy
consistent: Existing Java schema, enumeration and seconds-format checks

up_to_date.ratings: Parseable seconds within the declared data range

empty_table: Applicable dimensions equal zero; inapplicable dimensions remain null
rounding: Report scores use two decimal places; retain integer numerators and denominators
